summary: Phase 2 (multi-tenant, deposit via Stripe, WhatsApp mock, cron reminders, super-admin) tested end-to-end. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass (public tenant endpoints, deposit flow, whatsapp mock persistence, cron auth + idempotency, tenant scoping for owner/superadmin, settings validation + revert, superadmin tenant CRUD, confirm-status → 'confirmed' message, blocks CRUD, service tenant isolation). Frontend: landing renders distinct hero_titles per tenant, slug-inexistente shows tenant-not-found. /s/gel-beauty booking flow displays deposit-box and pay-deposit-btn redirects to checkout.stripe.com. /s/barbearia-vintage booking omits deposit-box. /payment/success without session_id renders payment-result 'Pagamento não concluído'. Super-admin sees tenant-switcher + tab-saloes; switching to Barbearia Vintage reloads services (Corte Clássico, Barba Completa, Corte + Barba). New tenant creation via new-tenant-btn shows card. Settings deposit_percent 20→30 round-trip via PUT /api/settings verified through public salon endpoint. Reminders tab renders reminders-cron-card + run-reminders-btn + messages-log. Owner login (barbearia@demo.com) does NOT see tenant-switcher or tab-saloes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~700 lines: acceptable but consider splitting auth/tenant/booking/admin routers into modules as it grows.

GET /api/cron/runs uses get_principal which requires a tenant; superadmin can access it via X-Tenant header. If an owner should also see runs of their own tenant only, add tenant_id filtering (currently returns all cron_runs across tenants).
AdminDashboard tenant delete relies on window.confirm; no page.on('dialog') was easy to intercept in tests — a proper modal confirmation with data-testid would be more testable.

Booking.js dates array is built with `new Date()` in local browser TZ then converted via ymd(); users in a different TZ than tenant.timezone may see slightly off day labels. Consider computing dates using tenant timezone.
payments.py silently swallows StripeError in status polling (line 109 pass). Consider logging.
